_readme: Where every non-studio image on the Wishbone THREE page comes from. Real first: Product Bay's six studio angles per colourway and its 4K product film. Generation only where neither shows the shot, always from the real photograph of that exact state, checked side by side against it, and labelled 'Generated' on the page.
signOff: NOT APPROVED. Generated imagery needs the owner's sign-off before anything customer-facing. The Shopify store is live and nothing here has been published to it.

history.what: All eight shots generated on gpt_image_2_5 flare/high from the single DSCF2323 studio PNG.
history.why: The owner found the trolleys deformed. On review: the fold was invented (an upright box with the wheels as its sides, front wheel folding first - the manual folds handle-first, front wheel last), the tyres were drawn knobbly (they are fine-tread), the Black / White was given a white sleeve it does not have, and the handle tubes took the White / Red course photo's cream. The cause was conditioning on one unfolded photo and asking the model to imagine every other state. Files deleted 2026-09-22.

modelTest.note: Same prompt and the same real references on three settings; each output compared side by side against DSCF2332.

boot.provider: OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 via the Higgsfield MCP connector
boot.prompt:
Image 1 is a real photograph of a folded golf push trolley. Place THIS EXACT OBJECT, unchanged, standing upright in the open boot of a modern estate car. Do not redesign, simplify, straighten or tidy it: keep its exact folded shape, the handle loop sticking up at the top, the black organizer console lying diagonally along the left side, the lime sleeve printed 'three', the two large lime three-spoke wheels on the right with their fine-tread black tyres, and the lower bag cradle at the bottom left. Image 2 shows the same trolley unfolded, for reference only.

Scene: camera behind the car looking into the open boot at boot-floor height, the folded trolley seen from the same side-on angle as in image 1, grey boot carpet, a plain black golf cart bag lying flat beside it. Soft diffuse daylight from the open tailgate, no flash, no people, no car badges or number plates, no text added.

colourways-course.provider: OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 via the Higgsfield MCP connector
colourways-course.note: First take (616edbbd) gave both trolleys cream handle tubes copied from the White / Red course photo; rerun with the colours pinned.
colourways-course.prompt:
Images 1 and 2 are real studio photographs of the same golf push trolley in two colourways. Image 3 is a real photograph of a golf course; use it ONLY for the location, light and camera - ignore the white-and-red trolley standing in it and take NO colours from it.

Recreate the exact scene of image 3 - same fairway, same trees, same sky, same soft light - with TWO trolleys side by side and no other trolley: the trolley from image 1 on the left and the trolley from image 2 on the right, both at the same three-quarter angle as in images 1 and 2, facing left, standing on the grass with soft shadows under the wheels.

Colour facts, exactly as photographed:
- LEFT, Black / Lime: every tube of the frame is matte dark charcoal-black, INCLUDING the curved handle tubes under the organizer console. Olive-lime wheel rims and an olive-lime sleeve on the upright printed 'three'.
- RIGHT, Black / White: every tube of the frame is matte black, INCLUDING the curved handle tubes. Mid-grey wheel rims. The upright is plain black with 'three' printed in white - no coloured sleeve.
Neither trolley has any white, cream or silver tube anywhere.

Reproduce both trolleys EXACTLY as photographed: identical frame geometry, thin dual upright tubes, the slim flat organizer console, the lower bag cradle at the front, one front wheel and two rear wheels with fine-tread tyres and three-spoke rims. Do not redesign, thicken or add any part. No people, no bags, no text added.

frames.caption: Stand bag
frames.provider: OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 via the Higgsfield MCP connector
frames.prompt:
Edit this real studio photograph. Change ONE thing only: replace the black cart bag with a slim, plain matte black golf STAND BAG - narrower and lighter-looking than the cart bag, with its two retractable stand legs folded flat against its back, a single shoulder strap, a few club heads showing at the top, no branding. It sits in exactly the same place: its base in the lower bag cradle at the front, its body strapped into the upper bag bracket below the handle.

Everything else stays pixel-for-pixel as in the photograph: the trolley's frame, its handle and organizer console, the lime sleeve printed 'three', the three lime wheels and their tyres, the camera angle, the framing, the lighting and the plain background. Do not move, redraw, restyle or tidy the trolley in any way. No text added.
